title: Fix PDF library initialization failure

requirements.text: Fix the PDF library (jsPDF) initialization failure that prevents PDF generation for all products on the backend

quotes: This time it says the PDF library failed to load

acceptanceCriteria: The jsPDF library loads successfully without throwing initialization errors
PDF generation completes for all three default products
No 'PDF library failed to load' error appears when generating PDFs

requirements.text: Ensure the PDF generation flow properly handles library loading errors and provides clear feedback if the library fails to initialize

quotes: the PDF generator itself didn't initialize, so the backend never even got to the product data

acceptanceCriteria: If jsPDF fails to load, the error message clearly indicates a library loading problem
The generation process does not attempt to create PDFs if the library is unavailable
Users receive actionable feedback when library initialization fails

constraints: The jsPDF library is loaded via CDN in frontend/index.html
Do not modify the backend Motoko code
Preserve the existing PDF generation workflow in frontend/src/lib/pdf/generateProductPdf.ts
nonGoals: Changing the PDF content layout or styling
